_comment: sg13g2-bandgap -- record spec for closed-loop-startup on the `klt sim` harness (issue #414, part of #412). Mechanics: sim/harness/klt_sim_evidence.py; argument: this file.
Claim: Co-simulating bandgap_core + bandgap_amp + bandgap_startup (trim-bearing core at trim_code=128, wired as design/bandgap_top.sch) with vdd ramped 0 -> VDD over 200 us, the assembled block self-starts and settles to a closed-loop operating point across the 45-point PVT grid: the startup circuit releases (v(det) <= 0.2*vdd, |i(XMKFB)| <= 50 nA), the loop closes (|sns1-sns2| <= 20 mV) and fb is not railed. Closed-loop plumbing evidence, not a claim against any spec row.
Netlist provenance: design/netlist/bandgap_core.spice (trim-bearing, trim_code=128), design/netlist/bandgap_amp.spice and design/netlist/bandgap_startup.spice, carried verbatim into sim/closed-loop-startup/testbench/closed_loop_startup.body.spice.tmpl (XMSENSE w= read from the live startup netlist).
PDK: `ihp-sg13g2` -- pinned release in sim/pdk.json; OSDI models built by sim/tools/build-osdi.sh (local) / baked into the batch runner image (#277).
Corner matrix run: process {typ,bcs,wcs,sf,fs} x temperature {-40,27,125} C x supply {2.97,3.30,3.63} V (45 points)
author: Loom Builder (agent), issue #414
